author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, sigue con las variables admisibles y el paso de incurrido a último. Revisa el clima de 2025, los reportes tardíos y las reservas, deja las decisiones en el foro y dime cuándo estamos listos para entrenar.

features.default: contractual period and physical address attributes under explicit stable-master assumption, plus policy tenure; no target-learned encoding or imputation
excluded: claim outcomes, target, fold, group, audit columns
features.conditional_profile: undated customer attributes, missed payments and gender kept outside default matrix
features.weather_variant: last complete calendar year before inferred quote_date = period_start - days_quote_to_inception; no fallback to current/future year; no 2025 weather cells used

capital_screen.action: derived log capital missing above screen; no divide by 1000; source retained; uncertainty flag excluded from predictors
capital_screen.evidence: separate clusters: buildings <=894000 vs >=60000000; contents <=283200 vs >=7600000; screening is a quality assumption, not an official cover cap

reporting.estimator: reverse product-limit for right-truncated delays, separately by line/peril
reporting.cdf: F(d_j)=product over d_k>d_j of (1-n_k/M_k); conditional observed-support model
reporting.cost_mark_adjustment: mass_j times mean observed net incurred at delay_j, normalized; accounts observed delay-cost association under stationarity and independent truncation; not observed ultimate
scopes: 2023 excluding group fold k, k=0..4; reused for development and cold-start
reporting.forbidden: no validation claim IDs, amounts or test labels in scope fitting
reporting.small_samples: report counts/influence; fail if a peril has fewer than five observations, no leakage fallback
reporting.tail: base assumes no additional delay/cost mass beyond fitted support; unidentified tail disclosed; design sensitivity adds 5% or 10% unobserved cost mass to long-tail perils bodily_injury/subsidence
reporting.development: case reserve already included in T0; base b=1 is a conditional adequacy assumption; stress b=.75/1.25 modifies only reserve before cost-mark curves
reporting.offsets: days-weighted mean of fitted reporting CDF over period times nominal exposure; cost mixture uses fit-only truncation-adjusted peril cost shares; 2025 prediction uses nominal exposure once, with no additional IBNR multiplier
reporting.evaluation: 2024 scored against observed T0 through matching observation link, plus reserve/tail sensitivity; no ultimate validation claim

acceptance: Every raw field assigned availability role
Default feature set exact and free of outcome/ID/operational/circular/weather columns
2025 weather poisoning leaves default and past-weather features unchanged
CDFs monotone in [0,1], event mass sums to 1, same tied delay handling; no division by zero
Reporting fitted IDs subset scope training, disjoint validation by saved split
Cost marks recomputed under reserve stresses, no double reserve or IBNR
Offsets finite, nonnegative and <=nominal; mixture positive for observed periods; test offsets nominal
Raw T0 and case reserves preserved; no fabricated ultimate truth
Reproducible pure tests and consumer verification
readiness: first pricing baselines only after default matrices and scoped observation link pass checks; ultimate interpretation remains conditional on stated case/tail/stationarity assumptions; no pricing model trained here
